title: Internal Project
description: A real-time internal monitoring dashboard using React and Next.js for HAUD System Indonesia to track A2P SMS traffic (OTPs, notifications, etc.), providing live logging and system actions.

title: Android A2P Automation
description: Automating probe testing using Android and Appium to capture and validate A2P SMS for analytics, aimed at helping network operators detecting and preventing fraudulent activity from applications or SMS API senders.

title: SafeCircle Mobile App
description: SafeCircle is a comprehensive mobile app using Flutter for neighborhood security with Emergency Alerts, Crime Mapping, and Community Safety Tools. It is designed to help users stay safe and connected with their neighbors.

title: SafeCircle Backend
description: SafeCircle is a backend service using Express.js, MariaDB, and JWT to provide API for SafeCircle mobile app.

title: Perintis (Penyiram Tanaman Otomatis)
description: An all-in-one automatic plant watering system using ESP32, Firebase, Angular, and Node.js. It lets users monitor and control the system from their phone, including soil moisture and temperature tracking.

title: Maverick: Jakarta
description: A Unity 2D game inspired by Flappy Bird but with a twist. It features a fighter plane that flies above Jakarta and the player has to avoid obstacles and shoot down enemy planes.
